identity: Sonata Appassionata, Camwell arrangement for alto saxophone and piano
findings: Dorn catalog distinguishes alto/piano DP1443 from soprano/piano DP1442.
This supports retaining separate alto and soprano edition records.
The original violin/orchestra work is generally identified as MS58; source dating varies between 1828/29 and 1829. The exact source/reconstruction used by Camwell needs checking.

evidence.claim: DP1443 alto/piano and distinct DP1442 soprano/piano
Original violin/orchestra work, MS58, date variants

gaps: Duration, full structure, exact historical source, edition date, score and recording unverified.
Do not use Karg-Elert Op.140 same-title recordings or Hekkema's Quartet-derived Sonata as evidence for this work.
